trust_decision.summary: Whether the string output of a TypoScript cObj (indexing field config) is turned back into PHP data by the indexer; at the pinned commit it is already decoded with json_decode, not unserialize, in both indexer resolveFieldValue paths.

landing_point.why: Record indexer resolves cObj field values and decodes multi-value payloads; the advisory title names multi-value cObjs, which point here and to SOLR_MULTIVALUE (Classes/ContentObject/Multivalue.php:50).

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The listed fix commits change only docs and version numbers (fix.diff:5-145); the real source fix (961f809e, 'JSON transport for multi-value cObjs') is already an ancestor of the pinned commit.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Not applicable: nothing is left to fix for this advisory at the pinned commit.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: SOLR_MULTIVALUE/SOLR_RELATION/SOLR_CLASSIFICATION must still populate multi-valued Solr fields from a JSON array, while plain-string cObj output stays a string.

O7_producer.where: Multi-value payload producer Classes/ContentObject/Multivalue.php:50-79 already emits JSON; no source change in the listed fix commits.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Reverting the page-indexer frontend-helper decode to unserialize() while AbstractIndexer stays on JSON would recreate a second-implementation sibling.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Page indexing runs in a separate frontend-helper path from record indexing and duplicates the decode logic; a maintainer could fix one copy only.

O9_family: insecure deserialization (CWE-502) of cObj output in the indexer

j.j_sites_touched: none (fix commits touch only Documentation/*.rst, Documentation/guides.xml, ext_emconf.php)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: n/a: the pinned commit already uses json_decode at both indexer sites

out_of_scope_notes: Classes/IndexQueue/PageIndexerResponse.php:49 still unserialize()s actionResults from the page-indexer HTTP response; different data source from cObj output, not pursued.
Classes/System/Mvc/Backend/Service/ModuleDataStorageService.php:42 and Classes/Task/EventQueueWorkerTask.php:72 call unserialize() on backend/DB state; outside this advisory.
